### aside: broadcast domains {.smaller}

*  broadcast domain = who you can reach with a broadcast
   *  if too large = hurts performance (extra frames, larger neighbor tables)
*  can also look at as within broadcast domain versus between
<hr class="vspace"/>
*  Ethernet-style forwarding + neighbor discovery
   *  within-broadcast domain design
   *  takes advantage of broadcast "backup"
*  can split layer-2 network into multiple broadcast domains
   *  more work for switches and/or different protocols
   *  possibly easier than splitting into multiple layer-2 networks connected at layer 3
   *  note: might allow A to broadcast to B and C, but B to only broadcast to A
